package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/yaklang/yaklang/common/bin-parser/parser/stream_parser"
)

type request struct {
	Sourcecase string `json:"sourcecase"`
	InputPath string `json:"input_path"`
	InputSHA string `json:"input_file_SHA256"`
	Offset int64 `json:"byte_offset"`
	Length int `json:"byte_length"`
	RawSHA string `json:"rawSHA"`
	Budget int `json:"budget"`
}

func main() {
	s := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin); s.Buffer(make([]byte,4096),1<<20)
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	for s.Scan() {
		var q request
		if err := json.Unmarshal(s.Bytes(), &q); err != nil { panic(err) }
		all, err := os.ReadFile(q.InputPath); if err != nil { panic(err) }
		if fmt.Sprintf("%x",sha256.Sum256(all)) != q.InputSHA || q.Offset<0 || q.Length<0 || q.Offset>int64(len(all)) || int64(q.Length)>int64(len(all))-q.Offset { panic("input contract differs from frozen source") }
		w := all[q.Offset:q.Offset+int64(q.Length)]
		h := sha256.Sum256(w); rawSHA := hex.EncodeToString(h[:]); if rawSHA != q.RawSHA { panic("selected PDU hash differs from source") }
		fields, decodeErr := stream_parser.DecodeOSPFv2Wire(w,q.Budget)
		message := ""; if decodeErr != nil { message = decodeErr.Error() }
		result := map[string]any{"sourcecase":q.Sourcecase,"rawSHA":rawSHA,"budget":q.Budget,"fields":fields,"error":message,"is_context":errors.Is(decodeErr,stream_parser.ErrObservedWireContext),"is_budget":errors.Is(decodeErr,stream_parser.ErrObservedWireBudget),"is_integrity":errors.Is(decodeErr,stream_parser.ErrOSPFv2WireIntegrity),"is_format":errors.Is(decodeErr,stream_parser.ErrOSPFv2WireFormat)}
		if err := enc.Encode(result); err != nil { panic(err) }
	}
	if err := s.Err(); err != nil { panic(err) }
}
